notes_for_editor: Very thin record. No NHLR or FFLOS registry number, no agency, no build date, no staffing or fire history in the sources read. Not found in the peakbagging California table under that spelling (search of the cached table returned no match). The Forest Lookouts list shows the September 2009 photo credit directly after the name; the page does not say which lookout the photo shows, so it is attributed to Tedoc only by its position in the list. A Facebook post titled 'Tedoc Rd Tehama County' mentions a fire lookout camera; the fetch tool could not read it, so it is not used. Story sits near the 120-word floor because the sources hold little; nothing was padded.
